title: Conservation and Stabilization of the Plaster and Decorative Paint at the President’s Room Ceiling, United States Capitol Building
agency: ARCHITECT OF THE CAPITOL.ARCHITECT OF THE CAPITOL.ACQUISITION & MATERIAL MAN DIV
description_text: The Architect of the Capitol (AOC); Supplies, Services, and Material Management Division (SSMMD) is issuing Request for Proposal (RFP) # AOCSSB26R0023 for Conservation and Stabilization of the Plaster and Decorative Paint at the President’s Room Ceiling, S-216, United States Capitol Building. This RFP will potentially result in the award of one (1) contract to the responsible Offeror that is actively registered in System for Award Management (SAM) and whose proposal provides the overall best value to the AOC in accordance with the requirements set forth by this solicitation and the Statement of Work (SOW). This solicitation will use the procedures in the AOC Contracting Manual, Chapter IX Acquisition Process, 9.1 Negotiated Acquisitions, 9.1.2 Source Selection Process, (a) Tradeoff Process. KEY DATES (see solicitation for further details): April 7- non-mandatory site-visit April 8- all questions due April 20- proposal submission deadline ______________________________________________________ Amendment 01 is to: 1. Issue responses to RFIs received as Section J attachment J.15 2. Issue an updated Section J attachment J.1- Statement of Work that adds sections 4.2 and 4.13.5 All other requirements remain unchanged, and the proposal due date remains the same.
